verdict.rationale: Ollama Cloud explicitly supports running larger models without downloading them (ollama-docs-8), with API key access requiring no local install (ollama-docs-20), and cloud base URLs for direct API use (ollama-docs-9). This directly matches the story of offloading large models to a hosted tier when local hardware is insufficient. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of cloud tier performance or reliability, and detail on pricing/capacity limits beyond marketing claims.
